authority_note: Cites 5 U.S.C. 552(a)(3)(B), 552(a)(4)(A)(ii), (iii) and (iv). Engineering draft written 2026-11-17; the citations and wording were not verified against official sources in that session and have had no legal review. The fee category text is chosen by the requester profile's fee_category because the owner has not decided who files; news_media is the expected primary category and its text uses the outlet facts from the profile's publication field. Political office and income are not federal FOIA fee categories or waiver grounds and are not used. Verify before any live use.
requested_fields: copies of the records already released in response to each listed FOIA request
subject: FOIA request: records released in response to ${request_label}
item: a copy of the records released in response to FOIA request ${tracking_number} (closed ${closed_date}, subject as logged: ${subject})

fee_categories.news_media: I am a representative of the news media under 5 U.S.C. 552(a)(4)(A)(ii)(II): I gather information of potential interest to a segment of the public, use my editorial skills to turn the raw materials into a distinct work, and distribute that work to an audience. I publish through ${outlet_name} (${outlet_url}), which reaches ${outlet_audience}. This request is made as part of that newsgathering and not for a commercial use, so fees, if any, should be limited to reasonable standard charges for document duplication.
fee_categories.educational: I ask to be placed in the educational institution fee category under 5 U.S.C. 552(a)(4)(A)(ii)(II). This request is made for scholarly research, not for a commercial use, so fees, if any, should be limited to reasonable standard charges for document duplication.
fee_categories.other: This request is not for a commercial use. I am an "all other" requester under 5 U.S.C. 552(a)(4)(A)(ii)(III), so fees, if any, should be limited to reasonable standard charges for search and duplication, without charge for the first two hours of search time or the first 100 pages of duplication (5 U.S.C. 552(a)(4)(A)(iv)(II)).
